description: Use this after search_services with the selected provider and package identifiers. Returns the exact server-revalidated price before confirmation and does not create a booking row. A quote needs no name, email, or phone. A provider package also returns the assignment deadline, after which an unaccepted booking is cancelled at no charge; it needs an exact start at least 2 hours away. An operator price quoted with the service address also returns slots, the open arrival times there on scheduled_date with the total for each; book one of those times. When none is open, slotsUnavailableReason says whether the address has no postal code, the postal code matches no address, or the provider does not serve it; otherwise quote another date. availableExtras lists the extras the provider sells with the job, such as sofa steaming; quote again with the ones the customer wants in extras to get the total with them, and book with the same extras. A package named for a unit count ("3 wall units") is refused for another number_of_units with reason package_unit_count; quote the package for the asked count instead. Other refusals say what to change: start_too_soon names the earliest start, price_changed the new price, invalid_catalog_version the current catalog_version_id, and quote_required means the package cannot be booked on Homejourney.

catalog_version_id.description: The chosen package's catalogVersionId from search_services.

customer_info.description: Optional. The service address (pickup_address for moving), only to list the open arrival times of an operator price.

extras.description: Optional extras from the quote's availableExtras, each id once with a quantity up to its maxQuantity. Each is charged at the operator's price and leaves the visit's length and start as quoted.

number_of_hours.description: Hours booked, for an offering priced per hour. The provider may charge a minimum number of hours.

platform_unit_count.description: Retired: Homejourney no longer offers its own catalog prices, so a launch_guide selection is refused. Leave it out.

price_source.description: The chosen package's priceSource from search_services.

property_size.description: Home size, for an offering priced by home size. A quote without it names the sizes the provider prices.

provider_id.description: The chosen package's providerId from search_services.

provider_package_id.description: The chosen package's providerPackageId from search_services.

service_details.description: The chosen package's serviceId from search_services, such as leak-repair. Put the customer's own words in issue_description.

singapore_time.description: Exact customer-selected Singapore start time in 24-hour HH:mm format. Do not send a time range.

name: quote_service_booking
title: Quote a Homejourney service booking
